rejectedMethods.reason: STEP exchange changes reconstructed rail trims; direct BREP preserves reference geometry but subtraction produces invalid solids. Invalid results were excluded from acceptance.
Two samples per direction are about .702mm from their own trimmed source surface. Projecting to the source boundary before target comparison removes the false outlier.

knownLimitations.description: Both original WASM and faithful native rails change volume when STEP exported and reimported. Native A123001.778mm3 becomes110511.326mm3, original WASM A123001.767 becomes110507.680. Native BREP and rendered/physical native geometry retain the validated shapes. No-pcurve export, SameParameter and ShapeFix did not resolve this; no runtime geometry was changed to mask it.

limitations: Kernel versions and STEP translation can produce different mass quadrature or trim tolerances. Volume comparisons are supplemented by Boolean or surface comparisons.
This records CAD migration equivalence, not physical calibration of contact, mass, inertia or mechanisms. Reviewed simulation collision approximations remain in use.
